name: Reclaimed Wood Floors in Seattle: Refinishing Without Killing the Character
title-tag: Refinishing Reclaimed Wood Floors in Seattle, WA
meta-description: A full sand erases the patina you paid for. What survives a recoat, a skip sand and a full flatten on reclaimed floors — from a Seattle refinishing crew.
post-summary: March 19, 2027 · On reclaimed wood, “looks new” is the failure mode. What character actually consists of, what each level of sanding destroys, the metal and grit hiding in salvaged lumber, and which finishes flatter texture instead of flattening it.
